description: This file defines classes and templates for constructing, manipulating, and validating Ethernet and IP (IPv4, TCP, UDP) frames, including checksum calculations and source/destination address handling within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: EthernetFrameType
classes.description: Template class representing an Ethernet frame with methods to load data, access MAC addresses, and retrieve frame data.

classes.name: IPv4FrameType
classes.description: Template class extending EthernetFrameType to handle IPv4-specific fields, checksum, source/destination IP addresses, TTL, and length.

classes.name: TCPv4FrameType
classes.description: Template class extending IPv4FrameType for TCP-specific frame handling, including source/destination ports.

classes.name: UDPv4FrameType
classes.description: Template class extending IPv4FrameType for UDP-specific frame handling, including source/destination ports and checksum validation.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads data into the frame buffer, respecting the maximum size.

methods.name: SourceMAC
methods.description: Gets or sets the source MAC address in the Ethernet frame.

methods.name: DestinationMAC
methods.description: Gets or sets the destination MAC address in the Ethernet frame.

methods.name: Source
methods.description: Gets or sets the source IP address in the IPv4 header.

methods.name: Destination
methods.description: Gets or sets the destination IP address in the IPv4 header.

methods.name: Checksum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum for IPv4, UDP, or TCP headers.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the frame based on protocol and checksum.
